name: Version 0.4.2
body:
- Add Debian and RPM packaging metadata and CI validation as groundwork toward official distro packaging
- Improve release and test workflows for distro packaging checks
- Refactor core application modules to simplify maintenance of CLI, execution, rendering, history, and diffmode handling
- Improve internal ANSI handling and remove older terminal dependency paths in favor of the in-tree ANSI support crate
- Update Rust dependencies and compatibility ranges for packaging-friendly builds
- Update README with packaging status and CI notes

This release is mainly a maintenance and packaging-focused update.
It does not introduce a large new end-user feature set, but it improves project structure and prepares `hwatch` for smoother distribution packaging on Debian- and Fedora-based systems.
